title: Highway flood
tagline: A national highway goes under with a truck already on it.
story: NH-715 floods at Kaziranga at 07:15 while Truck T3 is driving on it. The Majuli ferry stops at 11:00, Morigaon is cut off at 15:30, and NH-715 reopens at 20:00.
watch: T3 re-routed around NH-715 the moment it floods, and the driver's alert
Morigaon's order recalled when the camp is cut off (flagged for a boat or air drop)
Static trucks waiting at the flood until it reopens

title: North bank cut off
tagline: Rivers split the north bank and a warehouse goes under.
story: The Subansiri closes NH-15 near Gohpur at 08:00. At 10:30, 1,500 people from Jiadhal-flooded villages reach the Dhemaji camp. The Jia Bharali floods the Kaliabor–Tezpur road at 12:00, the Kolong floods the Nagaon warehouse yard from 12:10 to 17:00, the Majuli ferry stops at 13:30, and the rivers recede in the evening.
watch: Dhemaji's 1,500 new arrivals: food and water re-planned within minutes; the 8 t load waits for the officer
Supply disruption: Nagaon warehouse offline, its order recalled, Morigaon supplied from Guwahati instead
The Supply agent re-orders North Lakhimpur's stock from its regional supplier
Honest gap: one truck is stranded when the Majuli ferry stops and no safe road is left

title: Lower Assam surge
tagline: Camps fill up faster than the supplies can follow.
story: The Beki river rises: 2,500 more people reach the Barpeta camp at 08:00 and 1,500 reach Goalpara at 10:00. The Nalbari–Barpeta road floods at 12:00 and reopens at 17:00. A relief consignment reaches the Guwahati hub at 14:00, and Morigaon is cut off at 18:00.
watch: Barpeta and Goalpara re-planned as people arrive; big loads need the officer's approval
Barpeta's order recalled the moment its only road floods (flagged for a boat or air drop)
The 14:00 consignment triggers an immediate re-plan
